LAND ACQUISITION NOTICE
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: Ser/5/5/19/Projects/Land.acq.(Ho/2017/03) Land Ministry No.: 4-3/9/2014/IR/348 C. I hereby notify under Sub-section (1) of the Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendments) Act No 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
